facts.text: Direct per-model manual tuning is best suited to unique machines or an immature physics model.
facts.quote: Unique machines or an immature physics model

facts.text: Direct per-model manual tuning is simple and understandable.
Direct per-model manual tuning recreates the historical multi-year tuning problem.
Direct per-model manual tuning is susceptible to engineer and test-set over-fitting.
facts.quote: susceptible to engineer and test-set over-fit

facts.text: To control over-fitting, restrict direct per-model manual tuning to residual calibration after the common physics model, rather than duplicating the full logic.
facts.quote: Restrict to residual calibration after the common physics model, not full logic duplication
